what: EPSG code for British National Grid corrected.
rationale: EPSG:2770 is an unrelated CRS; OSGB36 / British National Grid is EPSG:27700.

what: Reference to non-existent attribute "peatDepth" replaced with surfacePeatDepth (also the label used in Figure 1).
as_published: ...and hence the peatDepth recorded is a minimum value only.
corrected: ...and hence the surfacePeatDepth recorded is a minimum value only.
rationale: The attribute is named surfacePeatDepth everywhere else in the standard.

what: Darwin Core mapping of easting/northing changed from verbatimLatitude/verbatimLongitude to verbatimCoordinates; new field verbatimSRS added.
corrected: easting + northing -> verbatimCoordinates (as '<easting> <northing>'); SRS in verbatimSRS
rationale: verbatimLatitude/verbatimLongitude are for latitudes and longitudes. Darwin Core holds projected coordinates in the single term verbatimCoordinates, with the reference system in verbatimSRS. The v1.0 text itself proposes adding verbatimSRS so eastings and northings can be used outside Great Britain. verbatimSRS defaults to EPSG:27700 when absent, so v1.0 data remain valid.

what: Example changed to an EPSG code; Darwin Core best-practice sentence added to the description.
rationale: "WGS: 1984" is not a recognisable datum identifier. Darwin Core recommends the EPSG code of the SRS where known.

what: surfaceElevation mapped to Darwin Core minimumElevationInMeters / maximumElevationInMeters (was measurementValue) and tied to a reference level; new field verticalDatum added, required when surfaceElevation is given.
corrected: surfaceElevation -> minimum/maximumElevationInMeters (cm / 100); reference level in verticalDatum
rationale: An elevation is meaningless without its reference surface. Darwin Core's verticalDatum is defined for exactly this and pairs with its elevation terms. The value stays in centimetres for compatibility with v1.0 data.

what: Missing closing parenthesis added to the description.
as_published: ...given in geodeticDatum of the geographic centre...
corrected: ...given in geodeticDatum) of the geographic centre...
rationale: Typo; brings the wording in line with latitude.
